fixed_law.rank: reduced float64 SVD; keep s>max(G.shape)*eps_float64*smax; zero span rank0
fixed_law.operation: K=J-Uretained*(Uretained.T*(J-R)); native varying material coefficients protected PRESTORE, J orthogonal correction/DC retained
fixed_law.after: Only one HALFnearest-even store and component-atomic allRGB pairedR fallback; NO laterM/remod/gather/Skip
fixed_law.fallback: Whole component on anychannel SVD/arithmetic or anypixel invalidnegative/nonfinite/saturated final RGB/HALF; unsupported domains/singletons pairedR
fixed_law.telemetry: Component/rank/coverage/fallback; changedarea vsR AND vsJ; pre/postHALF protected-span RMS drift
